title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 24: the lamp and the holy bread, the son of Shelomith who blasphemed the Name, and one law for all.

questions.text: What were the Israelites to bring for the lamp that burned continually?
questions.explanation: They were to bring pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

questions.text: During which hours was Aaron to keep the lamp in order before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Outside the veil in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron was to keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh continually.

questions.text: How many cakes of fine flour were to be baked and set on the gold table?
questions.explanation: They were to bake twelve cakes and set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table.

questions.text: How often was the bread to be set in order before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually.

questions.text: Who was the father of the son of the Israelite woman who quarreled in the camp?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says the son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, strove with a man of Israel in the camp.

questions.text: What was the name of the blasphemer's mother?
questions.explanation: His mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

questions.text: What did they do with the man while they waited for Yahweh's will?
questions.explanation: They put him in custody until Yahweh's will should be declared to them.

answers.text: They sent him out of the camp
They let him return to his tent

questions.text: Who were to lay their hands on the head of the man who cursed?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that all who heard him were to lay their hands on his head, and all the congregation were to stone him.

questions.text: What was to be done to someone who injured his neighbor?
questions.explanation: Verses 19-20 say it shall be done to him as he has done: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth.

answers.text: He was cut off from his people
It was to be done to him as he had done
He had to bring a trespass offering

questions.text: What does verse 22 say about the law for the foreigner?
questions.explanation: Verse 22 says there is to be one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born.

answers.text: The same law applies to the foreigner and the native-born
The foreigner is judged only by the priests
The foreigner may pay a fine instead of punishment
The foreigner is not bound by this law at all
